observations: The shortened Skill retains catalog/character/battle/capability scope and excludes general D&D rules, history and lore.

It requires describe_mcp_workflow once per connection, then current legal choices, returned arguments, input schemas and recovery; detailed execution conventions remain in that guide and current responses.
It retains same-journey recovery, OAuth credential boundaries, explicit saved-session choice, permanent deletion warning, batching independent character choices and honoring user delegation.
It retains pending-versus-applied outcome semantics, actual rolls, checkpoint-owned HP/resources/effects and table-geometry distinction.
The changed instruction to report in game terms removes unnecessary protocol narration while preserving progress and unresolved-input disclosure.
These are static source-based predictions with inherited prior context and visible expected cases; no model activation, tool execution, OAuth, persistence or installed-product behavior was observed.
